card.name: Digits inside numbers in science text
card.fires_on: Mostly a single digit inside a longer number, such as grant, report or cell-line codes and percentages, in science or research web text. Also fires weakly on scattered words in research news.

modes.label: Digit inside a code or number
modes.description: A digit partway through a grant number, report ID, year, or confidence figure.

modes.label: Scattered words in research writing
modes.description: Occasional ordinary words in science news or methods text with no shared theme.
